mapper.select: SELECT m.symbol AS symbol, p.id AS pool_id, p.name AS name, p.pool_type AS pool_type FROM stock_pool_members m JOIN stock_pools p ON p.id = m.pool_id WHERE m.symbol = #{symbol} AND (p.is_archived IS NULL OR p.is_archived = false) ORDER BY p.id
SELECT symbol FROM fundamental_concept_member WHERE concept_id = #{conceptId}

SELECT d.symbol FROM fundamental_daily_basic d JOIN (SELECT symbol, MAX(trade_date) AS md FROM fundamental_daily_basic GROUP BY symbol) t ON t.symbol = d.symbol AND t.md = d.trade_date WHERE d.total_mv >= #{minTotalMv}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tech_kline_daily WHERE symbol = #{symbol}
SELECT MIN(date)::text FROM tech_kline_daily WHERE symbol = #{symbol}
SELECT MAX(date)::text FROM tech_kline_daily WHERE symbol = #{symbol}
